latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Editor Anup — an AI-powered cloud video editing tool for fast, professional edits and easy 1080p MP4 exports.
- Supports uploading raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and processing with simple text prompts (“cut the pauses, add background music…”).
- All editing and export operations handled via secure backend API; no complex software needed.
- Automatic session handling with anonymous token support and free starter credits.
- Built-in error handling for token/session issues, credit balance, file support, and export permissions.
- Clear user feedback with real-time status updates and timeline previews.
